mentions.name: 1987 Jeep Wrangler rebuild
mentions.description: This is a personal project to tear into a 1987 Jeep Wrangler and undo 40 years of modifications on the vehicle, undertaken together with the author's son.
mentions.source_excerpt: My son and I are about to tear into a 1987 Wrangler. This is going to be very helpful when we're undoing 40 years of modifications on this thing.
